title: What If Aliens Called Once and Never Again? The Wow Signal

scenes.text: What if aliens called once and never again? In 1977, a telescope heard 72 seconds.
Ohio's Big Ear telescope caught a narrow, powerful burst on one of 50 radio channels.
Days later, astronomer Jerry Ehman spotted it on a printout and wrote Wow in red ink.
It was the strongest signal Big Ear ever detected. It rose, peaked, then faded.
Astronomers watched that patch of sky for a month. Nothing. Big Ear searched for 24 years and never found another.
Comets, planets and satellites were checked, and none matched. One signal, no repeat, and still no explanation.

description:
What if aliens called us once and never again?
On August 15, 1977, Ohio's Big Ear telescope heard a 72-second signal that has never repeated and has never been explained.
What should we run through next?
